author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Retroid Pocket 4 Pro Review: PS2 and GameCube for $199!
summary: Retro Game Corps reviews the Retroid Pocket 4 Pro as a complete $199 handheld, placing its PS2 results beside ergonomics, display quality, software, benchmarks and competing emulation workloads instead of judging the device from one game.

blocks.text: The forty-three-minute review builds toward PS2 testing rather than beginning with a highlight reel. It records pricing, unboxing, size, weight, comfort, screen comparisons and the Android software experience before benchmarks and multiple emulator families. GameCube, Wii and PS2 arrive after those foundations, so performance can be weighed against portability and controls. The manufacturer supplied the review unit, but the creator states that no money changed hands and the company neither previewed nor approved the review.

The launch price excludes shipping and can no longer describe the current market. Firmware, emulator builds and community profiles have also evolved since January 2024, while a chapter-level PS2 segment cannot cover the full catalogue. Affiliate links are disclosed. Use the review to understand the original product balance, then check current thermal behavior, trigger reliability, battery condition and software support before buying. A handheld that runs selected demanding games well may still need per-title settings or fail workloads absent from the test.
